upload.name: EDGEbuilder
upload.description: EDGEbuilder {version} for game 2.5, a world builder inside the game. Needs REDnode 0.58.0 or later and Codeware; REDbridge 0.12.1 or later (Get REDbridge in EDGEdeck) for the asset list and baking. Install with Vortex or EDGEdeck, or extract into the game folder.
